settings.title: Korean CarPlay turn-by-turn on the cluster and HUD
settings.description: Korea Projection's fit, beside the official Wireless CarPlay + Android Auto mod (keep its Turn-by-turn on): an arrow for every maneuver, the near-turn view and distance bar as the car's own navigation draws them, lanes, rerouting text, and a resend every second. While it has guidance, the official mod's cluster calls in DiPO get its values, and in the car navigation only the bar slot of its trap frame (where the cluster draws the near-turn gauge) gets the phone's bar; cameras and speed limits stay as they are. Off: the official mod's turn-by-turn as it is.

settings.title: Far turns as the road picture too
settings.description: With Korean turn-by-turn on: a turn farther than the near-turn distance (600 m, expressway exits 1050 m) shows the same road picture with the distance bar full, not the turn icon in a box (a long straight stretch too, as the straight-ahead picture, with the next road's name); the bar shrinks from there as before. At a turn change, the icon box no longer flashes between two pictures. Destinations, waypoints, the start and ferries keep their icon. Off: far turns as the icon box (Korea Projection's way).

settings.title: Log the CarPlay turn-by-turn diagnosis
settings.description: Adds Korea Projection's diagnosis lines: the near-turn decision (lanes, distance, D), what was sent to the cluster, lanes, and the navigation app's first name. Numbers otherwise, when they change, a few hundred lines at most per start. With it, the HUD list sent too (up to 300 lines; the official mod logs its own), and each official mod's call held for ours, whether it carried ours or passed as it was (up to 100 lines per guidance, 20 for one call). Off, these are still logged: the maneuver values received (type, side, junction, angle, up to 300 lines), a change of navigation app (both app names) and turn-by-turn cleared. No road or place names either way. Off by default: turn it on to collect a log of a turn-by-turn problem.
